capabilities: Comment on any selected passage with markdown, threaded replies, editing and deletion
Propose GitHub-style ```suggestion edits that render as a diff and apply with one click
Store comments as plain YAML in the note's frontmatter under an obelisk key
Browse, filter and navigate a note's comments in a sidebar with in-text highlighting
Read and write comments from outside Obsidian via an npm CLI and an MCP server for agents
extras: The README states the plugin is early and has not been exercised against a large vault. The CLI and MCP server are distributed on npm as obelisk-mcp; agent setup docs live in docs/agents-fragment.md rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to leave threaded comments on passages or propose one-click replacements that stay attached to the note as it moves through sync, git, export and rename.

relations.evidence: For an agent that speaks MCP, register the server with it

summary: Inline commenting plugin that anchors comments to text passages and offers GitHub-style suggested edits, stored in the note's frontmatter.
